comparison.objective: Physically test a faucet fault and report the diagnosis; candidate iteratively tunes damper response.
comparison.physical_skill: Handle manipulation to distinguish working, cannot-open, or cannot-shut faults, then tag placement versus tool-based adjustment, relocking, guarded cycling, and impact interpretation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct report for the hidden faucet condition versus two safe dynamic stops plus witness-torque drift tolerance. Faucet motion/report thresholds and separate spec versions were not provided.
comparison.reason: Both infer mechanism state through action, but diagnosis-and-report tests a different ability from closed-loop mechanical calibration.
